setups.name: ATH Magnet
setups.desc: Leader within reach of its all-time high: momentum and attention pulling it through.

setups.name: Leader Pullback
setups.desc: Leader back at its 21 EMA, uptrend intact, sellers drying up: buy the dip, not the chase.

setups.name: Rotation Rookie
setups.desc: A theme or sub-theme money is newly moving into; the stock hasn't run yet.

setups.name: Qullamaggie Flag
setups.desc: High-ADR top performer basing in a tight flag after a big leg (any theme). Buy the flag break, stop low of day, hold 3-5 days, trail the 10 EMA.

setups.name: Round Number Magnet
setups.desc: Strong stock a short hop under a big round number ($50, $100, $200...): the level draws price in, and a clean break above it often runs.

setups.name: Minervini VCP
setups.desc: Young Stage 2 trend tightening up with volume drying out. Buy the pivot break, stop under the last contraction (max 8%), hold while above the 50-day.

setups.name: Box Retest
setups.desc: Broke out of a box or a multi-touch range, snapped back to the old top and just bounced off it, in a strong group (sub-theme above its 50-day or top-20% sub-theme/theme). Buy, stop under the retest low, target = box height above the top. Paid best right after a breadth thrust.

setups.name: Box Spring
setups.desc: Broke below a box or a multi-touch support, failed, and just closed back inside the box (a spring / bear trap), in a strong group. Buy, stop 0.5 ADR under the old bottom, target the top of the box. Paid best right after a breadth thrust and in washed-out tapes; in-vogue themes add more.

plan.summary: First Integrator plan. Nothing new is proven this week: macro fit still fails, and the forward log for the agent layers has no settled ideas yet (first ones settle around Oct 22-23). The biggest untapped edge is already in the research: the 'spring' (failed breakdown, trap_long) after a breadth thrust made +0.46R (t 6.6, worked after 5 of 6 thrusts) but is not in the playbook, and we are in a post-thrust window right now (Oct 15). Best next step: confirm its halves and per-thrust results, then add it to the post-thrust playbook during this weekend's 'review my trade setups' session.

review.summary: Nothing is proven yet, so nothing should change. The macro-fit layer still fails its backtest: setups with a recent macro tailwind did worse, not better (+0.40% vs +2.03% over 5 sessions, t -1.65, both halves negative), so it stays information only. The forward log has no settled ideas yet (48 carded ideas from Oct 15-16 are all still open; the first ones settle around Oct 22-23), so the catalyst, earnings, red-flag and macro-brief layers cannot be judged. Separately, the setup review flag is up (breadth thrust Oct 15, Minervini VCP slumping, leadership rotated), which is worth a 'review my trade setups' session.
findings: Macro fit, 5-day (backtest Mar 31 2025 - Oct 8 2026, 6,268 signals, 243 dates): tailwind +0.40% (n 1,006) vs headwind +2.03% (n 800), diff -1.63 pts, t -1.65, halves -1.9 / -1.4 pts → NOT PASSED (wrong direction, and t below 2).
Macro fit, 20-day: tailwind +1.16% vs headwind +1.05%, t -0.28, halves -1.2 / +1.3 pts → NOT PASSED (no difference).

Macro fit by setup: every setup leans the same way (headwind better); only Round Number Magnet reaches |t| above 2 (-2.28 pts, t -2.27, n 317/188), halves not tested per setup → a hint of mean reversion, not a rule.

Forward decision log: 48 ideas carded (Oct 15: 25, Oct 16: 23; 2 pick1, 2 pick2, 37 candidates, 7 watch), 0 settled over 0 dates → too thin, no test possible for catalyst, red flags (7 ideas flagged), earnings inside hold (6 with a date), m
Top 2 scoreboard (pick_ledger): 12 picks Oct 9-16; 9 open, 1 no fill (ABCL), 2 pending; none closed yet → no results to report.

Setup review flag is ON: breadth thrust Oct 15 (post-thrust playbook favors Rotation Rookie +0.35R, Leader Pullback +0.29R, VCP +0.29R); breadth Weak 3+ sessions vs the Mixed baseline; Minervini VCP -0.25R over its last 75 signals; Box Rete
proposals: No layer changes yet: not enough data. Macro fit stays information only (failed its backtest); agent layers stay flags until ~60 settled ideas over ~20 dates (about late November).

Keep watching the macro-fit mean-reversion hint (headwind beat tailwind in both halves, strongest in Round Number Magnet); if it reaches t of 2 or more with both halves agreeing, test it as a contrarian flag (needs your approval).

Consider a 'review my trade setups' session this weekend: the review flag is up for the Oct 15 thrust, the VCP slump (-0.25R last 75 signals) and the leadership rotation. This is the existing setup review, not a layer promotion.

layers.text: Oil eases from five-month highs after Trump waives some Russia sanctions, pulling the 10-year yield to about 5.09% and lifting Nasdaq futures ~1% ahead of Meta and Tesla earnings Wednesday.

macro_fit.rule: tailwind = macro moves of the last 5 sessions imply > +0.25% for the stock (real sensitivities only); headwind < -0.25%; result = actionable 5-session return of each Trade Setups signal

brief.headline: Oil eases from five-month highs after Trump waives some Russia sanctions, pulling the 10-year yield to about 5.09% and lifting Nasdaq futures ~1% ahead of Meta and Tesla earnings Wednesday.
brief.rates: The 10-year Treasury yield slipped to about 5.085% early Monday as oil fell, but yields remain high and have pressured tech.
brief.oil: Brent fell about 2% to ~$107.6 and WTI to ~$99.5 after Trump's Oct 16 order waived some Russia sanctions, but Hormuz tanker attacks and mines keep Gulf exports near 8.5M bpd vs 20M+ before, holding crude near $100+.
brief.fed: The Fed is in its blackout period with no speakers this week; markets price about 88% hold / 12% hike for the Oct 27-28 FOMC and roughly 75-80% odds of a hike by December.
brief.geo: Iran-linked attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continue (another tanker hit a mine), while the US Russia-sanctions waiver is under a review of up to 60 days.

reasons.text: Breadth has been Weak for 3+ sessions; the setups were chosen in Mixed breadth. In weak breadth so far: Round Number Magnet -0.02R, ATH Magnet +0.03R, Leader Pullback +0.17R, Rotation Rookie +0.12R, Qullamaggie Flag +0.38R, Minervini VCP +0.17R.
Leadership has rotated: 3 of the top 5 themes are new since the review (HEALTHCARE - Services, TECH - Software, BIOTECH - Pharma).
